entries.summary: Die vier Regenten des Bischofs von Freising Philipp Pfalzgraf bei Rhein, Johann von Lamberg (Domdekan zu Freising), Ruprecht Auer (Domherr), Michael von Rosenberg (Hofmeister) und Warmund von Fraunberg zum Huebenstein, verleihen dem Georg von Welsperg den halben Hof zu Zell unter Welsberg, das Halbe Gut zu Winkel hinter der Burg Welsperg und ein Gut zu Toblach als Zinslehen. S: Johann von Lamberg Or. Perg., 1 anh. Siegel

entries.english: We, named below, Johann von Lamberg, Domdekan zu Freising, Ruprecht Auer, Domherr, Michael von Rosenberg, Hofmeister, and Warmund von Fraunberg zum Huebenstein, at this time all four appointed, fully empowered deputies, regents and councillors of the most worthy, high-born prince and lord, lord Philipp, administrator of Freising, Count Palatine of the Rhine, Duke in Bavaria, our gracious lord, publicly acknowledge with this letter that we have granted to the noble and steadfast Georg von Welsperg, on behalf of his [?], the following properties and holdings, namely the half farm situated at Zell below Welsperg above Our Lady's church, likewise the half holding at Winkel behind the castle Welsperg, and a holding at Toblach, with their appurtenances. We also grant him, knowingly and by virtue of this letter, whatever we rightfully ought or may grant therein, so that from now on he may have, use and enjoy them as a fief, as is lawful by fief-right of the lordship of Freising, yet without prejudice to our gracious lord, his successors in the lordship over the fief, and anyone else in their rights. He shall also pay the customary Zins from it annually into the Kasten at Freising. In witness whereof we give him this letter, sealed with the appended seal of me, the aforementioned Johann von Lamberg, under which we three named above intend hereby to be bound. Given at Freising on the Friday before St. Michael's day, in the year one thousand four hundred and ninety-nine.

facts.content: was one of the four appointed, fully empowered deputies, regents and councillors of Philipp, Administrator zu Freysing, Pfalzgraf bei Rhein and Herzog in Bayern.

granted Georg von Welsperg as a fief half a farm at Zell under Welsperg, half a holding at Winkel behind Schloss Welsperg, and a holding at Toblach, jointly with Hans von Lamberg, Domdekan zu Freising, Ruprecht Auer, Domherr, and Warmund von Fraunberg zum Huebenstein.
sealed the grant of the fief to Georg von Welsperg with his appended seal, under which the other three regents also bound themselves.
